offers_products.reason: Manufactures cooling towers, fans, boilers, electric heaters, locators, and fare-collection and navigation equipment.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly engineered products; aftermarket service and parts are secondary to the HVAC and detection equipment.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Mostly sold to contractors, engineers, utilities and governments; residential boilers go through contractors, so homeowners are not main buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells cooling towers, air handlers, locators and fare systems to contractors, utilities, transit agencies, militaries and facilities.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly equipment sold per project or replacement cycle, such as cooling towers, boilers and air handlers; aftermarket is smaller.

cyclical_demand.reason: Equipment tied to new construction and industrial capital spending, such as cooling towers, fans and air handlers, can be deferred.

big_ticket.reason: Cooling towers, custom air handlers, boilers and fare systems are large, infrequent capital purchases for buyers.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from manufactured engineered products and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Many buyers are contractors, engineers and facility owners across fragmented markets; large government and utility buyers exist but are not dominant.

asset_heavy.reason: Discrete manufacturer of engineered niche products with assembly plants; not a heavy-asset network or fleet business.

notes: Large-customer and asset-heavy answers are judgment calls; the HVAC segment is the larger part.
